tools.name: search_assets
tools.description: Search 7,000+ assets: free CC0 handmade PBR materials, HDRIs, decals, 3D models, IES, atlases, landscapes, and AI-generated materials, HDRIs/skyboxes, decals, atlases, heightmaps, animations (UE5/Mixamo), 3D models, alpha brushes. Returns id, title, type, license, price in credits (0 = free), thumbn

tools.name: get_asset
tools.description: Full details of one asset: description, tags, license, price, whether it can be downloaded through the API and whether the user already owns it.

tools.name: download_asset
tools.description: Get signed download URLs for an asset (valid about 30 minutes). Free CC0 assets: no cost. AI assets: charges their price ONCE (then free forever, added to the user's library) — pass max_credits after the user accepted the price. Requires a connected account.

tools.name: list_generators
tools.description: All 3D Texel AI generators: which ones run through this API (with parameters and price examples) and which ones are website-only (with their URL).

tools.name: quote_generation
tools.description: Exact credit price of a generation before running it (and the user's balance when connected). Always show this price to the user before generating.

tools.name: generate_pbr_material
tools.description: Seamless PBR material from a text prompt: albedo (base color), normal, roughness and height maps. Realistic or stylized. Precise layouts (herringbone, chevron, Versailles parquet, basket weave, hexagon tiles...) are drawn exactly so they tile. Asynchronous: returns a generation id; poll get_generati

tools.name: generate_hdri
tools.description: 360-degree equirectangular HDRI panorama / skybox from a text prompt, true HDR (.hdr) plus an LDR preview image. Realistic or stylized skies, interiors, landscapes. Asynchronous: returns a generation id; poll get_generation. Spends credits (refunded automatically on failure). Typical time: 150 s.

tools.name: generate_texture
tools.description: One AI image from a text prompt (optionally from a reference image): sprites, flipbooks, emissive or UI textures, concept images. No PBR maps: use pbr-material for tileable materials. Asynchronous: returns a generation id; poll get_generation. Spends credits (refunded automatically on failure). Typi

tools.name: generate_3d_model
tools.description: Textured 3D model (GLB) from an image or a text prompt. texel-3d-pro = state of the art, highest quality, HD texture with PBR maps (base color, metal/roughness, normal); texel-3d-alt = another excellent option, PBR maps; texel-3d-express = fast, decent quality (~20K triangles, PBR); texel-3d-draft =

tools.name: get_generation
tools.description: Status of a generation: queued, running (with progress and poll_after_seconds), succeeded (with file URLs and license) or failed/canceled (with refund information).

tools.name: save_generation_to_library
tools.description: Publishes a succeeded generation (PBR material, HDRI) in the public 3DTexel community library and adds it to the user's library. Free. Only when the user asks.

tools.name: cancel_generation
tools.description: Cancel a running generation; its credits are refunded.

tools.name: get_balance
tools.description: Credit balance, spending limits of this connection and recent credit movements.

tools.name: list_my_library
tools.description: Assets the user owns (re-download for free).

tools.name: list_credit_packs
tools.description: Credit packs and prices (EUR/USD). Credits never expire.

tools.name: create_checkout_link
tools.description: Returns a 3dtexel.com link where THE USER buys a credit pack and pays himself. This tool never pays and never touches payment details. Give the link to the user, then check get_balance.
